phases.name: Phase 0: Belege am Gerät und Weg entscheiden (Spike, 1 bis 2 Tage)

tasks.name: Nur lesend: während RESAMPLING die Zustandswörter `0xFF9031F8..0xFF90320C` lesen (Quelle = Master-Wort?), Ringzeiger `0xFF9031D8` bei laufendem Spettro lesen
tasks.note: Nov18 READ baseline through ssh linux, USB SOUND, channel10. Spectrum service uninitialized; Spettro is not installed on the device. Prepared a tested catalog plugin outside the repository; owner explicitly deferred installation and device measurements. No writes or device EXEC sent.

tasks.name: Im DSP-Sim: Erfassung starten, Quellzeiger umbiegen, Ring gegen das gepackte Master-Wort vergleichen (bit-gleich); Stufe ab `0xFFA0189A` und `[P4+0x6C]/[P4+0x70]` benennen
tasks.note: GNU Blackfin probe passes: 4 stereo/mono packing cases, capture start, 4803 frames, source changes and ring wrap. DMA descriptors validated; physical DMA and concurrent host-port timing remain untested.

tasks.name: AUDIO IN und Metronom im Master: Abgriff nach AUDIO IN, vor Metronom
tasks.note: GNU Blackfin differential cases pass: independent left/right THRU, click, mixed input and click, muted click, and boundary before 0xFFA018E0. ARM call chain identifies the metronome trigger.

tasks.name: Mit OK: Kartenschreibtest am Gerät (64-KiB-Blöcke, 60 s, 12,5 und 25 MHz): Rate, längste Schreibpause, Pausen beim Clusterwechsel; Testdatei danach löschen
tasks.note: Device measurement pending; no device writes or execution authorized in this implementation session.

tasks.name: Mit OK: Laufabstand eines Lesers messen (CommandTask vs. eigene Task) während Pattern-Wechsel, WRITE (Flash-Löschen) und Sample-Swap-Laden; Ergebnis längste Lücke in ms
tasks.note: Device measurement pending; no device writes or execution authorized in this implementation session.

tasks.name: Entscheidung A/B/C in die Messung schreiben: A, wenn die längste Leserlücke unter 80 ms bleibt; sonst C (DSP-Ring im Sample-Speicher) oder B
tasks.note: Path A is the provisional implementation baseline. Its 80 ms deadline is an unverified design bound, not a measured reader gap. Final A/B/C decision awaits device measurements.

criteria.description: Messdatei hat Zahlen zu Abgriff, Kartenschreiben, Leserluecke und Entscheidung A/B/C

phases.name: Phase 1: Master auf die Karte, ein Knopf (2 bis 3 Tage)

tasks.name: Aufnahmedienst: Erfassung mit der gewählten Quelle, SAMPLING sperren; Spettro zeigt Master oder ist während der Aufnahme nicht wählbar; DSP-Ring lesen und R/L zu L/R drehen
tasks.note: Native tap, reader, source ownership and SAMPLING/capture-app interlocks implemented. Focused reader, runtime and hook tests pass; both complete sampler patch sets pass the native recording card cases.

tasks.name: DSP-Abgriff mit THRU und Ausgangsverstärkung, ohne Metronom; Ausgang bitgleich prüfen
tasks.note: GNU DSP patch probe: 8 cases, audible output bit-exact, tap equals click-free output including THRU and saturation; marker and source fingerprints checked; boot/heap and RAM collision guards pass.

tasks.name: Nativer Ring-Leser mit Besitzprüfung, R/L-Konvertierung und sichtbaren Lückenfehlern
tasks.note: 13 native reader cases; locked exact-size DSP writes verified with native firmware in both sampler emulator profiles. Snapshot-age and stop ownership regressions pass.

tasks.name: Schreiber in einer Task, die die Karte darf: WAV-Kopf 512 Byte (JUNK), Daten in 64-KiB-Blöcken anhängen, beim Stopp Längen setzen und schließen; Dateiname fortlaufend im Aufnahmeordner
tasks.note: Native WAV writer and task-owned service implemented; whole 64-KiB unit cases and the native deadline-abort card case pass. Physical write latency is not verified.

tasks.name: Nativer WAV-Schreiber: eigener FIL-Kontext, exklusive Dateinamen, Sektorkopf und Fehlerabschluss
tasks.note: 11 native Unicorn cases pass; writer remains a library until the recording service is connected.

tasks.name: WAV-Schreiber im Aufnahmedienst an die kartenzugriffsberechtigte Task anbinden
tasks.note: Permanent CommandTask hook and dynamic heap controller verified through native panel-to-card cases on both sampler builds; allocations survive failed closes and are freed after finalization.

tasks.name: SHIFT + REC um RECORD ergänzen; Start nur über RECORD, unabhängig von PLAY; Zeit, Karte voll und Schlafsperre
tasks.note: Native SHIFT+REC third source, REC-only start/stop, filename/PCM time/error display and keep-awake verified by nine hook tests, native UI inspection and integrated sampler cases. PLAY leaves the native setup and does not record.

tasks.name: Emulator: DSP-Modell/QEMU liefert ein bekanntes Signal im Master-Wort; Fall prüft die WAV auf der virtuellen Karte (Kopf gültig, Frames bit-gleich, Länge stimmt), Fall-Modul im Verify-Scope angemeldet
tasks.note: recording_cases registered in check.py and verify-scope. Complete patch sets pass 15 recording checks each on Hacktribe and stock, including explicit 80 ms deadline failure. Four exact DSP-stream checks and eight scope checks pass.

tasks.name: Patcher-Tabelle, Messung, Schalter unter FEATURES (aus = kein Verhalten)
tasks.note: Default-off sampler FEATURES option, patcher labels in eleven languages, parent patch set and runtime RAM reservation implemented. All three runtime manifests rebuilt; targeted RAM and patcher table checks pass.

criteria.description: Emulatorfall WAV auf virtueller Karte bit-gleich auf Hacktribe und rot

phases.note: Software tasks pass. Hardware acceptance and final path A/B/C selection remain pending; no long-set or device success is claimed.

phases.name: Phase 2: Lange Sets ohne Lücke (1 bis 2 Tage)

tasks.name: Lückenzähler: Leser erkennt überholten DSP-Ring und ARM-Ring-Überlauf; Anzeige und Marker (cue-Chunk oder Logdatei), nie stilles Verschlucken
tasks.note: Terminal reader gaps, lost ownership and ARM overflow get a labelled cue in the reserved WAV sector header. Gap count is visible and persists after close. Writer/service/controller/UI tests and 17 complete-patch recording checks per sampler build pass; no lost-frame count is fabricated and no extra streaming write is added.

tasks.name: ARM-Ring nur während der Aufnahme dynamisch belegen, Größe nach Phase 0 bis 2 MiB; Speicherplan mit Sample Swap abstimmen
tasks.note: Task-owned heap allocation attempts 2 MiB down to 128 KiB in powers of two and publishes actual capacity. Native full boots obtain 1 MiB in the general heap, separate from the Sample Swap reservation at 0xC274F000..0xC4000000. Allocation/failure/free-boundary cases pass; hardware capacity and path choice remain unmeasured.

tasks.name: Andere Kartenschreiber (Einstellungen, Patterns, Plugins, Sample Swap) während der Aufnahme: warten lassen oder seriell, mit Fall
tasks.note: UI writes/readers are gated; start waits for a UiTask boundary, including a preemption case during FS_OPEN. Thirty focused tests and native deferred WRITE cases pass on both sampler builds. Native pattern writes share CommandTask (253 FS_WRITE hits, same task as recorder hook). Sample Swap #166 is still open and cannot yet be integrated or verified.

tasks.name: UI-Kartenzugriffe sperren, gepufferte Änderungen nachholen und Start an UI-Grenze freigeben
tasks.note: Thirty focused cases; complete sampler patch sets each pass 26 recording checks. Native WRITE queues settings without flash fallback; exact WAV PCM; input/frame task identity traced.

tasks.name: Native Pattern-Schreiber und Aufnahme in derselben CommandTask nachweisen
tasks.note: Targeted native export and export-all cases pass. 253 FS_WRITE calls and 3034 recorder command-loop hits execute only task5; UI frame task4 is separate.

tasks.name: Sample-Swap-Kartenzugriffe nach Integration von #166 prüfen
tasks.note: PR166 is still open against develop. No firmware work on that parallel branch; integration remains pending.

tasks.name: Stromausfall: Längen regelmäßig nachtragen oder Reparatur beim Start (Länge aus Dateigröße), mit Fall
tasks.note: Periodic data-before-header checkpoints implemented, including faulted finish. 38 focused core tests and 31 integrated recording checks pass on each sampler build. Native SD images at 12 healthy and six injected-sync-failure boundaries retain valid PCM prefixes. First card error remains visible; physical mid-sector power loss is not tested.
